description: Creator dashboard services management page at app/dashboard/creator/services/page.tsx with service creation form, services list, edit/delete/toggle actions. Includes custom hook useServices for data fetching. Matches existing dashboard glassmorphism aesthetic and animation patterns from app/dashboard/page.tsx.
steps: Create hooks/useServices.ts following pattern from hooks/useCreators.ts and hooks/useBriefs.ts. Export useServices() hook with: services state (CreatorService[]), loading state, createService(data), updateService(id, data), deleteService(id), toggleActive(id), refreshServices() functions. Use createClient() from lib/supabase.ts for API calls.

Create app/dashboard/creator/services/page.tsx. Protected route - redirect to /login if no session. Structure: page header with 'My Services' title and 'Post New Service' button (opens modal/form), services grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4), service cards with glassmorphism (glass-card class, border-white/5), each card shows: title, truncated description, skills as tags, price range badge, delivery time, active/inactive toggle switch, Edit/Delete action buttons.

Implement service form (inline or modal): fields - title (input max 100 chars), description (textarea max 500 chars), skills (multi-select with CreatorCard skill list or manual tags - use existing skills from types: 'Video Editing', 'Motion Graphics', 'Color Grading', 'Sound Design', 'Scriptwriting', 'Storyboarding'), priceRange (select dropdown with 5 options), deliveryTime (select: '1-2 days', '3-5 days', '1 week', '2 weeks', 'Custom'), portfolioItems (optional, up to 3 - array of {url, title} objects, simple text inputs). Form submission calls createService hook, shows success toast, clears form.

Add edit functionality: clicking Edit on service card opens same form pre-filled with service data, submission calls updateService(id, data). Delete shows confirmation dialog (use native confirm or simple modal), calls deleteService(id). Toggle active/inactive uses Radix UI Switch component (already in dependencies) or simple button, calls toggleActive(id).

Style following app/dashboard/page.tsx patterns: gradient primary action button (from-violet-600 to-violet-500), glass cards with hover effects (hover:border-violet-500/20, hover:-translate-y-1), Framer Motion animations (initial={{opacity:0,y:20}} animate={{opacity:1,y:0}} staggered by index), skill tags with pill style (text-xs px-2 py-1 bg-violet-500/20 text-violet-300 rounded-full border border-violet-500/30), responsive layout.
acceptance_criteria: useServices hook successfully fetches creator's services from API
Page loads and displays 'My Services' with grid of service cards
Post New Service form accepts all fields and validates required inputs (title, description, skills, priceRange, deliveryTime)
Form submission creates service, shows success toast, refreshes list
Edit button pre-fills form with existing service data, saves updates
Delete button removes service after confirmation
Toggle switch changes is_active status in real-time
Page matches glassmorphism aesthetic: glass cards, gradient buttons, border-white/10, violet-cyan gradients
Animations match existing dashboard: cards fade in with stagger, hover effects with scale/translate
Mobile responsive: grid collapses to single column on mobile
verification: Navigate to /dashboard/creator/services (add navigation link or access directly)
Click 'Post New Service', fill form, submit - verify service appears in grid and in Supabase dashboard
Edit a service - verify updates persist
Delete a service - verify it disappears
Test on mobile viewport (Chrome DevTools) - verify responsive grid
Verify glassmorphism: cards have backdrop-blur, glass effect, gradient borders on hover
findings:
Implementation completed successfully:
- Created hooks/useServices.ts with services state, loading, createService, updateService, deleteService, toggleActive, and refreshServices functions
- Created app/dashboard/creator/services/page.tsx with authentication check and creator role validation
- Service form includes all required fields: title (max 100 chars), description (max 500 chars), skills (multi-select from predefined list), priceRange (5 options), deliveryTime (5 options), portfolioItems (optional, up to 3)
- Services displayed in responsive grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3) with glassmorphism cards
- Each card shows title, description, skills as tags, price range badge, delivery time, active/inactive toggle (Radix UI Switch), Edit and Delete action buttons
- Styling matches app/dashboard/page.tsx patterns: glass-card, gradient buttons (from-violet-600 to-violet-500), border-white/10, Framer Motion animations with stagger
- Form validation implemented for all required fields with error messages
- Success toasts using 'sonner' library for all CRUD operations
- Edit pre-fills form with existing service data, Delete shows confirmation dialog
- Build passed successfully with no TypeScript errors
- Real-time updates via Supabase subscriptions
- API routes already existed and were used correctly
